name: Subrina Miller
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Subrina Miller is a lead community liaison for the Inglewood Unified School District. She is the CEO of the Heads Up Foundation, which helps families in Inglewood and surrounding areas. Her campaign says she has been a neighborhood association president and citywide advocate for two decades.

sentences.text: Subrina Miller is a lead community liaison for the Inglewood Unified School District.
She is the CEO of the Heads Up Foundation, which helps families in Inglewood and surrounding areas.
Her campaign says she has been a neighborhood association president and citywide advocate for two decades.

items.text: She says her goals are to make the city affordable, build affordable housing, and keep taxes low. She also says she would use community meetings, workshops, and newsletters to keep communication with the community. In 2024 the Los Angeles Rams named her a pLAymaker for her work helping families.
